args.text: Global equity markets posted significant gains on Friday as investors reacted positively to third-quarter earnings reports from major technology firms. The rally was broad-based, with European and Asian indices also closing higher amid renewed optimism. Analysts suggest that easing inflation data may have contributed to the confidence in risk assets. Trading volume remained above average throughout the session as institutional buyers returned to the market. The S&P 500 index rose 1.2 percent while the Nasdaq Composite gained 1.5 percent. Bond yields stabilized following the equity surge.
